'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jeffrey Johns LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' jademasters
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
